status: Fixed final exploratory algorithm comparison, agreed by user before execution

models.LR: Frozen V2 B without month terms
models.G1: Exactly the same information and frozen preprocessing as LR
models.G2: G1 plus local_category_share and log_relative_share; additional preprocessing fit only on training data

early_stopping.selection: best_iteration_ recorded by callback, no AP selection, no cap extension

splits.revision_evaluation: April 1-May 2 2018: 7893/87, already viewed in V1 and V2

evaluation_order: Train and save both models and a locked iteration/hash record before generating evaluation predictions

bootstrap.scope: paired fixed predictions, no model refitting or early-stopping re-selection

interpretation: AP point improvement with both bootstrap intervals above zero permits only clear ranking improvement in this exploratory comparison. Otherwise insufficient evidence. Probability deterioration is a tradeoff, not overall superiority. No extra regional gain does not establish regional irrelevance.
ties: Stable customer ID ascending order for equal scores, as in LR; report boundary ties
stop_rule: Only G1 and G2, one parameter setting, one seed. No retuning, new features, calibration, post-development refit, or extensions based on evaluation outcomes. Record genuine implementation fixes separately.
preservation: Hash all V1/V2 result and work artifacts before and after; new work/output directories only
